verdict.rationale: Instinct is itself an autonomous personal-assistant agent, so it fills the MCP client role, and serving tools to other agents through an official MCP server is a different product role. Nothing in the pack shows it running as an MCP server: no serve mode and no hosted MCP endpoint. Its agent-to-agent 'Trusted People' feature works only between Instinct agents and is not an MCP server, and the vendor's public surface lists no developer, API or MCP pages.
